Options: - Keep “scripts/” in archives (remove it from archive.exclude), or - Move the logic into a PHP class invoked via an autoloaded CLI entrypoint that ships in the archive, or - Guard the composer script with a file_exists check to no-op when “scripts/remove-mpdf-fonts.php” is absent.
